host_processor_frequency: 2.2 GHz max set for the runs (4.12 GHz boost)
host_processor_caches: L2 1 MB per core; L3 1 GB per socket (32 x 32 MB)
host_storage_capacity: 8x 7.68 TB (node 1), 1x 7.68 TB (node 2); shared NFS home and /work
host_networking: 8x 200 Gb/s HDR InfiniBand per node (4x NVIDIA ConnectX-7 dual-port)
host_networking_topology: Single NVIDIA Quantum QM8700 HDR switch, 8 HCA ports per node
host_memory_configuration: 1.5 TB per node, 12 x 128 GB DDR5 RDIMM (cockpit inventory; 48 slots)
accelerator_frequency: SM clock locked to 345-1050 MHz (nvidia-smi -lgc); board power limit 390 W
accelerator_interconnect: NVLink bridges: two 4-GPU NVLink groups per node (GPU 0-3, 4-7); PCIe Gen5 between groups
accelerator_interconnect_topology: 4-GPU NVLink groups within a node; 8 x HDR InfiniBand per node between nodes
hw_notes: Giga Computing G494-ZB4-AAP2 servers. For the 10 kW facility budget: GPU board power limit 390 W per GPU (nvidia-smi -pl), SM clock locked to 345-1050 MHz (nvidia-smi -lgc), host CPUs on the performance governor with scaling_max_freq 2.2 GHz, chassis fans pinned at 40 % in the BMC. Page cache dropped before every run via a setuid helper (vm.drop_caches=3).
other_software_stack: CUDA 13.2, cuDNN 9.21.1.3, NCCL 2.29.7, Transformer Engine 2.14.0, Megatron-Core 0.18.0, mlperf-logging 6.0.0-rc6 (pkg 4.1.51), NVIDIA driver 580.173.02, Slurm 26.05.4 with pyxis/enroot
sw_notes: Runtime kernel add-ons (source-or-patches/ntu_scc/addons, attn_bwd, deepgemm_dgrad) are loaded via a site-packages .pth autoload and bind mounts; the benchmark source is unmodified. See source-or-patches/ntu_scc/README.md.
